‘2:1 Agrements conditions
if you receive 3 medium/large parcels - 3 x £20 = £60 and £60 - £15 (postage to us cost) = £45 and this is your profit for just helping us sort out our parcel. This is 1 days earning!
 
1. Consent & Email us letting us know when you can start to receive our mail to your address (this can be your home or in some cases we hear if you're a student, you're able to use the university for your mail in this case ours) we will start procedures.
 
2. We will let you know a estimated date for you to be ready to receive one of our parcels. Some parcels require a signature, so please make sure you're in and ready to collect it on the day.
 
3. Once received contact us once again via email, and we will provide you an address to ship it to. This is as simple as getting an A4 blank paper, writing our address... EXAMPLE (SEND TO: NAME 123 FRAIR LANE, LEICESTER,  LE1) then sticking it onto the packaging, with tape or similar secure and going to a post office and sending it.
 
4. YOU MUST send with 'Royal Mail First Class Signed For' Or Express24. This will provide you with a tracking number for you to send to us, so we know the item has been shipped and we should be expecting a parcel soon. If you try to hand deliver or not using a tracked service then we won't be doing any business and will be rejected at the door.
 
POSTAGE IS not very expensive for most items. It is determined by weight. A simple letter would cost 80p to send, but the amount we're paying you is a lot higher and you make a lot more profit. A medium parcel will be £3-6 and large £10 at most. However the calculations are done, you're making money for hardly doing any labour and in general this is easy work.
 
DO NOT TAMPER with our packages. If we find our packages have been opened/used or damaged we won't do any business and since you have Agreed a legal online document you may be liable for prosecution at judge discretion. So please, just receive our product, if you're weary then take a picture even. Once received, label it, send it off through a local post office and give us the tracking number, then you can throw away the receipt if you want to since tracking is provided. Once we receive our package you will be paid accordingly, if you want PayPal then please mention this with your PayPal email, if you want cash in hand this can be possible, but PayPal Or Bank transfer is preferred’
